notes: All 83 source and 121 sink candidates from extraction/sources.csv and extraction/sinks.csv were labeled in 13 stable batches (S1-S7 sources, K1-K6 sinks); every candidate received exactly one label, keyed by file+line+node+callable (ids src-001..src-083, sink-001..sink-121 in CSV order).
Dedup: 0 duplicate rows by file+line+node+callable+flowKind+argIndex; 0 rows excluded - all 204 candidates appear in entries (grounded labels, not silently dropped).

Trust model: the Pass 1 attacker is the REMOTE HTTP client of the FastAPI webserver (src/fides/api, fastapi 0.89.1 + Starlette). Click CLI params (17 source rows) and os.getenv env reads (11 source rows) are operator/deployment trust and labeled none/fp; request-field reads that only feed logging/analytics/audit-DB are none/fp; SaaS auth strategy request reads are Pass 3 territory.

Confirmed Pass 1 chain (CWE-22, arbitrary file read): GET /{catchall:path} -> request.path_params['catchall'] (main.py:160, source/tp) -> get_path_to_admin_ui_file fallback (main.py:167 -> ui.py:32-42 pathlib '/' join, summary/tp) -> ui_file.is_file() (main.py:170, sink/tp secondary existence oracle) -> FileResponse(ui_file) (main.py:180, sink/tp primary). match_route (main.py:163) is a safe fixed-map selector whose regex classes contain no dots, so traversal payloads always take the vulnerable fallback branch.

Sanitizer warning: path_is_in_ui_directory (ui.py:134-141, `ui_directory in path.parents`) is a LEXICAL check on the UNRESOLVED path - pathlib keeps '..' as an ordinary component, so the guard PASSES for ui_dir/../../... payloads (verified with pathlib semantics). Both sanitizer entries are classification=fp and MUST NOT be rendered as isBarrier in Phase 2; doing so would suppress the confirmed finding. No effective sanitizer exists anywhere on the chain (no resolve(), no relative_to on resolved paths, no '..' rejection, no basename).

Zero real path sanitizers were confirmed in the whole tree; symlinks: no symlink creation or link-following policy exists in the audited code, and the packaged admin UI directory is not attacker-writable, so symlink-based TOCTOU is not applicable (recorded, not observed).

Pass 4 carry-over (manual-review point): the register_custom_connector_template zip body (saas_config_endpoints.py:363) is a genuine untrusted upload boundary but never reaches a filesystem path in this pass (BytesIO-backed ZipFile, in-memory member reads, no extract-to-disk); its .py members reach RestrictedPython exec (connector_registry_service.py:445-478) - flagged for the Pass 4 labeling round.

Phase 2 generation note: only classification=tp entries should be rendered into MySources/MySinks/MySummaries predicates; the two sanitizer/fp entries exist to document the REJECTED guard, and a MySummaries taint step for pathlib __truediv__ (package_path / ADMIN_UI_DIRECTORY / path) is required to bridge ui.py:32 to the sinks (AST '/' BinaryExpr is not extractable - detection.json uncoveredCases).

Labels grounded in the real fides_vuln source tree (database creation sha 1212eadf); the pathlib lexical-parents bypass claim was verified by executing the guard semantics (Path('/a/b/c') in (Path('/a/b/c')/'..'/../'x').parents == True).
